premises.text: Consumer wearables and GPS are too imprecise for professional sport improvement that needs inch-accurate multi-point motion tracking
premises.evidence_span: They are more motivators than real professional tools

premises.text: QOSP provides inch-accurate position plus acceleration and speed with multiple simultaneous observation points
premises.evidence_span: the only device with which you can do that, in which you can have multiple observation points as well as an inch-accurate positioning response, that's the QOSP

premises.text: Differential GNSS fusion of device and access-point satellite signals (inspired by unmanned-vehicle guidance) delivers the patented inch-accurate positioning
premises.evidence_span: Signals are received by the QOSP devices and the QOSP access point, which fuses the motion readings and corrects the satellite signal using the technique called differential GNSS positioning

premises.text: APIs expose acceleration, position, and speed readings so the platform can extend beyond sport to gaming, drones, and animation, while go-to-market focuses on team sports
premises.evidence_span: Its APIs were specifically developed to get the readings of acceleration, position, and speed in the most convenient way

premises.text: Patents on sensor networks and indoor/outdoor positioning create a distinctive competitive advantage in the team-sport market that lacks real-time tactic, injury-prevention, and scouting tools
premises.evidence_span: Beastar owns several patents on sensor networks, on our indoor and outdoor positioning system. And therefore, we have a distinctive competitive advantage over the competition

value.text: Athletes and teams get professional-grade motion tracking to improve performance (e.g., cut times, better swings)
value.evidence_span: Tracking your development is the answer for those who want to achieve a goal

causal_links.evidence_span: if you really want to improve, if you really want to cut your times, you need to decelerate three feet before the flag instead of five
You can see the angle with which we hit the ball. You can see the strength with which we hit the ball
You can use it in gaming, quadcopters, or even animation
there is no technological solution for teams

notes: Ski/tennis improvement examples folded into precision-need problem (§4.1.6). Multi-point tracking and differential GNSS kept as mechanism plus enabling tech package; patents treated as separately asserted GTM/IP advantage per §4.1.1 because speaker frames competitive advantage. API/platform vs razor-sharp team-sport focus coded as one GTM/platform premise. Market spend figures treated as framing. Four-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
